programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: The case of Gretchen Anthony, a woman known for her vibrant and positive personality, unfolds as a chilling tale of domestic violence and deceit; in March 2020, her estranged husband, David Anthony, murdered her in their Florida home.

programs.title: My Sister's Double Life
programs.desc: When Chelsea's sister vanishes after a late-night shift at a diner, she tries to convince the police that she's been abducted. Racing against the clock, she soon discovers that her sister's captor is now after her as well.

programs.title: What We Inherit
programs.desc: After discovering his ancestors were both pioneers and enslavers, Kacim journeys through the complexities of his American and Algerian heritage, confronting histories of conquest, slavery, and the weight of an inherited legacy.

programs.title: Chosen Family
programs.desc: Yoga teacher Ann cannot escape her manic family, miserable dating life, and inability to say no, leaving her constantly trying to fix everyone else's problems. Things start looking up, however, when her friends set her up with a divorced dad who has an adorable 7-year-old daughter.

programs.title: The Boy That Never Was
programs.desc: Forced to put their own troubles to one side, Robin and Harry seek a local policeman's help to track down Ollie.

programs.title: Code of Misconduct
programs.desc: Inside a London, Ontario courtroom, journalist Rick Westhead bears witness as five former members of the 2018 Canadian World Junior hockey team stand trial, forcing a reckoning within Canada's national pastime.
